edges.reason: Release time is validated against block.timestamp, making constructor logic depend on miner-controlled time.
release() gate uses block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value, to authorise the withdrawal.
Timestamp-derived releaseTime_ is written into the immutable _releaseTime used as the vesting gate.
Constructor stores the supplied ERC20 token into _token.
Constructor stores the supplied address into _beneficiary.
releaseTime() exposes the stored _releaseTime value.
beneficiary() exposes the stored _beneficiary value.
token() exposes the stored _token value.
release() reads releaseTime() to compare with the current time.
release() uses beneficiary() as the destination of the token transfer.
release() obtains the token instance through token() to query balance and transfer.
Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is validated and assigned to _releaseTime.
Locally computed token balance feeds the transfer amount inside release().
Assembly-assigned size variable is the return basis of isContract.
account parameter is passed to extcodesize inside isContract.
recipient parameter is the call target inside sendValue.
amount parameter is forwarded as the call value inside sendValue.
target parameter is the address of the delegatecall.
data parameter is the calldata of the delegatecall.
token parameter determines which ERC20 is called by safeTransfer.
to parameter is encoded into the transfer calldata.
value parameter is encoded into the transfer calldata.
returndata buffer is decoded to validate the optional boolean return of the token call.
release() transfers the full token balance to an external beneficiary with no reentrancy guard.
safeTransfer routes the encoded call through _callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom routes the encoded call through _callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove routes the encoded call through _callOptionalReturn after the allowance check.
safeIncreaseAllowance routes the approve call through _callOptionalReturn.
safeDecreaseAllowance routes the approve call through _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn performs the external token call via Address.functionCall.
Two-argument functionCall delegates to the error-message overload.
functionCall(address,bytes,string) delegates to functionCallWithValue with zero value.
The three-argument functionCallWithValue overload adds a default message and forwards the call.
functionCallWithValue executes an unguarded low level call with value on a caller supplied target.
functionCallWithValue checks the target holds code via isContract before calling.
functionCallWithValue passes success and returndata to verifyCallResult.
Two-argument functionStaticCall delegates to the error-message overload.
Two-argument functionDelegateCall delegates to the error-message overload.
functionDelegateCall validates the target with isContract before delegating.
functionDelegateCall executes an unrestricted delegatecall to the supplied target.
sendValue performs an unguarded native call forwarding all gas to an arbitrary address.
The external token transfer can re-enter release() before state accounting is settled.
A malicious recipient can re-enter sendValue through its fallback while the call is in flight.
The called target can re-enter functionCallWithValue through a fallback with gas available.
Delegated foreign code runs in this contract's context and can re-enter its entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only exists to initialise the _token state variable; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter only exists to initialise the _beneficiary state variable; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter is compared to block.timestamp and stored into _releaseTime; fold it into the constructor node.
Transient balance variable is only meaningful inside release() and drives its transfer amount.
Assembly scratch variable is scoped to isContract and cannot escape it.
Parameter is consumed immediately by extcodesize inside isContract.
Parameter is only used as the call target inside sendValue.
Parameter is only used as the forwarded call value inside sendValue.
Parameter is only used as the delegatecall target inside the function.
Parameter is only used as the delegatecall payload inside the function.
Parameter only selects the ERC20 instance used to build the transfer call.
Parameter is only encoded into the transfer calldata of safeTransfer.
Parameter is only encoded into the transfer calldata of safeTransfer.
Returned bytes buffer is only decoded within _callOptionalReturn to validate success.
